title: Constructible internal Hom over a regular base of dimension at most one
statement:
Let $S$ be a Noetherian regular scheme of Krull dimension at most one [def-weil-regular-scheme, def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], and let $\ell$ be a prime invertible on $S$. Let $X\to S$ be separated of finite type [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Put $A=\mathbf F_\ell$ and use ordinary small-etale derived categories of constant-$A$ module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For every $M,N\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes], the derived internal sheaf Hom satisfies
$$R\mathcal Hom_A(M,N)\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$$
[def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. No dualizing object, biduality, potential pinning, or purity hypothesis is assumed.

source.place: Proposition 3.15, regular-base alternative (a), for constructibility; Proposition 3.14 with Proposition 2.29(1) for bounded Tor amplitude, specialized to the field A=F_ell. Independent low-dimensional finiteness input also stated in ILO Expose XIII Theorem 2.3.1(i); finite-dimensional cohomological bound in Expose XVIII-A Theorem 1.1 and Corollary 1.4. The regular-base case uses classical dimension-at-most-one finiteness, not the quasi-excellent/Gabber alternative or the dualizing results in section 3.
